In October 2026, a video from Algeria's Aïn Defla province went viral. Activist Hamid Fradj asked an orphaned bride what she needed for her wedding, and she answered, "Just two chickens," to feed her guests. Her simple request touched people across Algeria. Donations began arriving from different regions, including furniture, gold jewellery, groceries and help with food and decorations for the celebration. Reports say thousands of people gathered to celebrate with her on her wedding day. The bride is reportedly from the village of Sidi Lakhdar. Some details shared online, including long-term financial support, have not been verified. What would you do if you saw this video?
